title: More on the Goodman date: Elman, Tilton, Krupa

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Well, this Goodman session is fascinating. And you say Ziggy Elman did one of those frillica (PHONETIC) --

Yeah, I remember that. Oh (unintelligible) I think there was Martha Tilton, and I think she did the vocal. I think she was on that session. One of those vocalists was on the session. I think it was Martha Tilton.
Yeah, I think she was with the band at that time. Did she sing on the Ziggy Elman thing?
And you say you think there were four songs. They were issued?
Well, that will give the researchers something to dig for.
Yeah, find out what happened. Because I was the bass player of record on there, because he didn't use his brother.
Yeah. Was Gene Krupa still in the band, or was Dave Tough playing, or --
No, Dave Tough wasn't playing. Gene Kruppa was in the band.
Gene was still in the band.
